Trading USDT on Binance P2P? Then you know the routine: update your ad price, fight for the top spot, wait for a match. Processing works differently.
On Binance P2P, you're a merchant on a marketplace. You hold USDT, run buy and sell ads, and earn the spread between them.
Do the math: a 1% spread on ₹1 lakh of volume is about ₹1,000. If the rate doesn't move against you.
And the risks are yours: price wars, slow days, buyers who mark "paid" without paying, appeals. One bad counterparty can get your bank account frozen.
A processing platform removes the marketplace layer. No hunting for buyers. Merchants send payment requests, and the system routes them to traders.
Here's a KoiPay PayIn. A client pays through UPI into your business account. The SMS Forwarder reads the bank SMS and confirms the payment automatically.
Anti-Fraud checks the operation, the merchant gets a callback, and your commission shows in the dashboard. PayOut works the other way: you send an approved outgoing payment.
KoiPay's rates are about 3% on PayIn, 1% on PayOut. So ₹1 lakh volume in PayIns is around ₹3,000; in PayOuts, around ₹1,000.
You earn per completed operation. Volume isn't guaranteed. It depends on routing and your limits. Your manager confirms your exact rates.
Your dashboard: incoming requests, statuses, limits, history and commission. The Telegram bot alerts you to new requests, and support works 24/7.
